title: Small-charge rigidity for the quartic Hartree shape energy
description: Unrefereed written-proof candidate. For sufficiently small positive charge, the ball uniquely minimises the three-dimensional quartic Hartree shape energy among all prescribed-volume competitors, modulo translations and the stated capacity or measure convention. Imports the published global existence and near-sphericity theorem; verifies the model-specific local flux argument and global transfer. No effective maximal charge, quantitative deficit, external peer review, formal verification or absolute priority is claimed.
